description:
My Property Box are delighted to welcome this two bedroom apartment to the market, situated within the popular Kirkley Lodge development.

Located on the second floor, the apartment is ideally positioned just off Park Avenue, within easy walking distance of Wansbeck Road Metro Station, nearby schools and the amenities of Gosforth High Street.

The property briefly comprises two well-proportioned bedrooms, both benefiting from fitted furniture, a part-furnished living room and a fitted kitchen with access to a private balcony. Further benefits include secure parking within the development-s courtyard, offering added convenience for residents.

Contact My Property Box today to arrange your viewing and speak to our lettings team!
